paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae

notes: Model-independent SN1987A cooling bound on QCD axion. Primary result presented on 1/fa vs ma plane (Fig. 5). Bound: fa > 1.1+0.4-0.6 x 10^8 GeV, equivalently ma < 5.3+7.3-1.3 x 10^-2 eV at 68% C.L. (note: not 90/95% - stated as 68% C.L.). Single exclusion point/threshold rather than a curve.
